CamAlert

Shows your IP cameras on the TV: on an Enigma2 receiver or a Kodi player (Kodi 19 or newer), controlled by Home Assistant, MQTT or its HTTP API.

This site has version @VERSION@. Latest release · Source code and documentation · Changes

Enigma2 receiver

Add the CamAlert feed on the receiver (via Telnet/SSH); the receiver's software update then keeps it up to date:

wget -O /etc/opkg/camalert-feed.conf https://@OWNER@.github.io/camalert/camalert-feed.conf
opkg update && opkg install enigma2-plugin-extensions-camalert

The feed line is src/gz camalert https://@OWNER@.github.io/camalert. Install guide for Enigma2

Kodi

Download the CamAlert repository for Kodi (@KODI_REPO_ZIP@), install it with Add-ons › Install from zip file, then Install from repository › CamAlert repository › Services › CamAlert. Kodi then updates CamAlert by itself. Install guide for Kodi

Home Assistant

In HACS (Settings › Marketplace) open ⋮ › Custom repositories and add https://github.com/@OWNER@/camalert with type Integration. Then install CamAlert, restart Home Assistant and add the integration under Settings › Devices & services. Install guide for Home Assistant

CamAlert is free software (GPL-2.0-only). This page sets no cookies and loads nothing from other sites.
